title: Running Toward Nothing in Particular
author: Jordan Ellis
body:
Most running advice is obsessed with destinations: races to train for, times to beat, distances to hit. Almost nobody talks about running with nowhere to be.

There's a specific kind of clarity that shows up around minute twenty, once your body stops complaining and your mind runs out of things to worry about. It isn't about performance. It's closer to meditation, just with better circulation.

No goal pace. No finish line. Just movement for its own sake.
